propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded, conflating 'author forgot to declare' with 'ticket genuinely touches no repo file'.
Undeclared tickets fall back to whole-HEAD freshness so any commit invalidates the plan-review attestation and forces re-review.
A single non-closed child with empty file_impact poisons the container's inherited drift scope to whole-HEAD.
Introduce a tri-state file_impact_scope of undeclared/paths/none with a required no_file_impact_reason for none.
A declared-none child is neutral in container roll-up (contributes nothing, poisons nothing) and passes P9.

The scope declaration is part of the material fingerprint so any state transition invalidates the attestation, and a new no-file-impact criterion uses LLM judgment to verify the assertion's truthfulness.
